_comment: Maps a configurator Base-class module code to a picture in this directory.
Filename matching already handles the obvious cases: the export's base code
'VX' finds 'Pilot VX.jpg' on its own. This file is for the exceptions - when
the code the configurator writes does not appear in the picture's filename,
or when two pictures match equally well and the skill would otherwise stop
Add an entry the first time a machine is quoted and the picture is not found:
the left side is exactly what the export's Base row has in its Module column,
the right side is a picture name from this directory (without the extension).
Codes are matched without regard to case, spaces or punctuation.
